name: Intramedullary Spinal Cord Tumor
definition: Neoplasm arising within the spinal cord substance, including ependymoma, astrocytoma and other lesions, capable of causing progressive myelopathy.

investigations.principle: Contrast MRI of the involved spinal cord is the key study; brain/whole-neuraxis imaging is selected by tumor type.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, tumor, occult injury or condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Biopsy/resection strategy depends on tumor type, location, neurological status and resectability.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Any Majja/Vata framework is secondary to modern oncological diagnosis and treatment.

patientEducation.summary: Neoplasm arising within the spinal cord substance, including ependymoma, astrocytoma and other lesions, capable of causing progressive myelopathy.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
